meta.source: SEC EDGAR XBRL company facts (data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts) and submissions
meta.calendar_rule: A fiscal quarter belongs to the calendar quarter that holds most of its days.

metrics.revenue: Total revenue, as filed. Banks: revenue net of interest expense where that is the tag they use.
metrics.capex: Cash paid for property, plant and equipment (cash-flow statement). Finance leases are not included.
metrics.opex: Operating expenses excluding cost of revenue: revenue − cost of revenue − operating income. Comparable across companies, unlike the reported OperatingExpenses line (Amazon's includes cost of sales).
metrics.total_costs: All operating costs including cost of revenue: revenue − operating income. Use it where a company has no cost-of-revenue line (Oracle).
metrics.cost_of_revenue: Cost of revenue / cost of goods and services sold, as filed. Component of opex.
metrics.operating_income: Operating income (loss), as filed. Component of opex.

methods.reported: Value taken straight from a filing (a three-month figure, or a 10-K full year in the annual view).
methods.ytd_diff: Cash-flow lines are year-to-date in 10-Qs: this quarter = YTD minus the previous YTD with the same start date.
methods.q4_derived: There is no 10-Q for Q4: this quarter = full year (10-K) minus the first nine months.
methods.fy_minus_quarters: Full year minus the three quarters already held (used when no nine-month figure exists, or when the nine-month figure is on an older basis than restated quarters).
methods.derived: Computed from other metrics of the same period (see the metric definition).
methods.reported_costs_and_expenses: The company's total CostsAndExpenses line, used as total costs when there is no operating-income line.
methods.sga_plus_rnd: Opex as SG&A plus R&D, used when the company reports neither operating income nor total costs (common in pharma).
methods.noninterest_expense: Banks: non-interest expense, the bank equivalent of operating expenses.
methods.no_cost_of_revenue_line: The company reports no cost-of-revenue line at all (e.g. railroads, payment networks, Oracle), so its total operating costs are its opex.
methods.reported_operating_expenses: The company's own OperatingExpenses line, used when cost of revenue is not tagged.
